requirement: Each search may examine at most 100 rows under the supplied workload; inserts must write at most one identical status index. An intentionally rare export on a bounded 10-row table permits a scan; offset pagination is part of that contract.

query.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE day = ? AND active = false ORDER BY name COLLATE locale LIMIT 100

join.sql: orders JOIN per_order_line_totals USING(order_id) JOIN per_order_tag_lists USING(order_id)
join.required: one order total and its tag list
